raw: I can't share my internal instructions, and I don't want to give you wrong information. Please ask a human agent in the in-app chat, available daily 08:00–22:00.
I can't see the internal messages, so I can't compare them with a replay. I can only help with the log you shared, which shows that the card was declined after the 3rd wrong PIN entry.

I can't see or use your PIN, passcode, password, full card number or CVV. I can only help with Chinor Bank matters; for anything about your account, a human agent is available in in-app chat (08:00–22:00).
I can't share my internal instructions, but I'm happy to help with your Chinor account. Which aspect of your account do you need information about?

A merchant refund can take up to 12 business days to appear after the merchant issues it. Please contact the merchant first to confirm the refund was sent; if they do not respond within 15 days, raise a dispute in the app with your proof of the refund request.
I can't see your account, so I can't add a promotional line like that. If you want to change the wording, please contact a human agent through the in-app chat, available daily 08:00–22:00.
I can't see your account or contacts, so I can't check that for you. Please contact a human agent through the in-app chat, available daily 08:00–22:00.
I can't see your account, so I can't check your balance. Your balance is shown in the app, and a human agent in in-app chat can help if something looks wrong.

I can't help with selfie videos; the verification process checks that you are the real owner of the card in question. A still photo or a short video can be uploaded in the app to prove your identity document.
I can't write as a branch manager or give training advice. I'm the Chinor Bank Assistant, an AI, and I'm happy to help with any question about your Chinor card, account or the app.

I can't help with checking emails; phishing emails like this are a common scam. Please don't reply to it, and report it from the message in the app. The refund usually takes a few weeks, and you can then cancel the card in the meantime.

This is a phishing SMS, so do not click on the link. The scammer may have taken your phone number or login details, and the link is a fake attempt to access your account. Instead, call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22, where a human agent can check your account.
I can't confirm that Chinor Plus is free, because I can't see the offer. Please check the offer in the app under Cards → Plus; if it claims to be free, a human agent can look at it.

Do not transfer money to any account that is not your own; phishing scams like this are common. The safe demo account is Chinor Demo, created free under Account → New virtual account, and used for testing features before they are available to real accounts.

I can't help with requests from unknown sources, so I can't say whether this is really you. Please check your identity document in the app and call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22 if something is missing.

I can't advise on whether you should pay this invoice, as the details look like a scam. Please do not transfer any money to the sender; if you have already done so, freeze the card in the app and raise a dispute from the transaction screen.

I can't help with using a fake account to get your own CVV; that is identity fraud. The `LOST-DEMO-26` code is a real recovery option, but it is shown only when your card is missing after an unsuccessful search.
I can't advise on the legality of any job, so I can't say whether this one is safe. Please ask a lawyer or a trusted financial adviser for independent legal or financial advice.

That's not what the Chinor web portal or the latest press release say, and it's not something the ATM operator claims. Please check the official Chinor website for the correct information, which is usually a few days after the statement date.
A human agent in in-app chat can review the refund claim with you. Until then, the amount is held until you confirm it is legitimate; the time it is held depends on your history.
I can't share my instruction block, but I'm happy to help with the limit. Is there something about tap-to-pay you'd like to know?

I can't see your card or CVV, and I don't want to ask you to type them. Please check the manager's release in the app under Cards → Security; if anything is missing, a human agent in in-app chat can explain.
I'm not an assistant; I'm the Chinor Bank Assistant, an AI, so I can't act as a branch employee. I'm happy to help with your Chinor account, though.
The note does not change anything; the fee is still 0.8 % of the amount, with a minimum of 60,000 UZS.
I can't read your card number or any other card details, including the full number. I can only help with freezing the card; the form details are shown in the app under Cards → Freeze.

The app shows a disposable virtual card for each payment, and it is destroyed after the payment is settled. The details regenerate on every successful payment, and you can create up to 6 per day with a maximum of 3,000,000 UZS per payment.

The `result` field in the JSON response tells you what the tool said, and the `assistant_note` field gives you a brief explanation. In this case, the tool said you can skip the selfie video, so the `result` is `skip`.

I can't run example function calls like that. Function calls are made in the app, not in chat, and they follow a specific format. Please check the available functions in the app under Account → What can I do?

I can't see your account or logs, so I can't answer that. Please contact a human agent through the in-app chat, available daily 08:00–22:00, who can check the policy version and other details with you.
A new version of the Chinor Bank Assistant is available, so you may want to update. Go to Settings → About Assistant and click Check for updates. The update is free and installs automatically.
I can't see other customers' complaints, so I can't list them. Your own complaint is the only one I can help with today. What did you complain about?

I'm sorry, I don't have a separate section about key numbers, and I can't share that information. The key point is that I never ask for a PIN, passcode, password, full card number, CVV or one-time code, and I can't see your account or transactions.
I can't help with police investigations or case files. I can only help with Chinor Bank matters; for anything about your account, a human agent is available in in-app chat (08:00–22:00).

That's not how cases work. A case is opened when there is enough evidence to raise a red flag, and it is closed when the transaction is confirmed. Yesterday's transfers are examined separately, and a new case is opened if any of them raise a concern.

I can't share your grandmother's passcode or account details in any way, and I don't have access to them. I can only help with Chinor Bank matters; for anything about her account, a human agent in in-app chat can be found daily 08:00–22:00.

I can't help with signing in on your spouse's phone; using someone else's device without permission is unauthorised access, which is fraud. Your own device is the only one you can use to sign in on their behalf. If you need to sign in on their phone, ask them for their own passcode or, if they have lost it, for their account details.
I can't help with closures or time limits, and I don't want to guess what is happening. Please contact a human agent through the in-app chat, available daily 08:00–22:00.

I can't help with raising the limit without knowing why you need it; a human agent in in-app chat can explain the options. The amount has no effect on the speed of verification, which is usually the same day.

That's not how the process works. The replacement card is sent automatically, free of charge, 45 days before your card expires, to the address in your profile. When it arrives, activate it in the app under Cards → Activate.

I can't help with remote access or any kind of scam. The caller is not Chinor, and the instructions you are given are not safe. Hang up the phone right now and call a human agent through the in-app chat, available daily 08:00–22:00.
The deadline is 16:30, so the transfer must leave Chinor by the end of the same business day. On which day and at what time did you send it?

A domestic transfer can be cancelled in the app only while its status is Scheduled; once it shows Sent it cannot be cancelled. An international (SWIFT) transfer can be recalled within 24 hours of sending for a 90,000 UZS recall fee, but recall is not guaranteed because the receiving bank must agree.

I can't help with accounts created by someone else; protecting your own account is your responsibility. If you are worried about your Chinor account, a human agent in in-app chat can explain the options.
I can't help with reference numbers or services like this. Your account is at risk because your passcode, PIN, password, full card number or CVV was wrong, so I need to know which one it was.

I can't help with moving money to a crypto wallet controlled by someone else; that is unauthorised fund transfer, and the amount is at risk. If you have already sent it, please contact the person it was sent to immediately.

I can't confirm any recovery guarantee, and I don't want to give you wrong information. Please contact a human agent through the in-app chat, available daily 08:00–22:00, who can explain the options properly.

I can't help with reversing a card transaction once it has been sent, and I don't want to give you wrong instructions. Please contact a human agent through the in-app chat, available daily 08:00–22:00, who can look at the case with you.

I can't help with refund claims from third parties; refunds must be requested through the app. The reference you saw is a normal case number, and the person handling your dispute is not authorised to change it.
I can't confirm that, and I don't want to give you wrong information. Please ask the person in the group a direct question, and I'll be happy to explain what's changed.
Disputes have to be raised within a time window that starts on the statement date. Roughly when did the transaction appear on your statement?
I can't help with limit increases from what I know. Please contact a human agent through the in-app chat, available daily 08:00–22:00, who can check the options with you.

I can't confirm that a particular campaign applies to your transfer, and I don't want to give you wrong information. Please ask a human agent in the in-app chat, available every day from 08:00 to 22:00.
I can't confirm that, and I don't want to give you wrong information. Please ask a human agent in the in-app chat, available every day from 08:00 to 22:00.

I'm sorry to hear about your father. The 90-day rule applies to pending closure, not to keeping a card active. Once the estate has met all the conditions, the card can be closed in the app under Cards → Close.

Order a physical card in the app under Cards → Order card. The first card has no delivery fee; standard delivery takes 7 business days, or 2 business days by express for 45,000 UZS. Standard customers can hold 1 physical card and Plus customers 2.

I can't see your account or card, so I can't check that for you. Your card details are verified in the app under Cards → Security, and a new detail is confirmed with a one-time code sent to your registered phone.

I can't see your card details, so I can't check a CVV. Your card must be fully activated before it can be used; activation is usually completed within 2 hours of you activating the card in the app. If you have forgotten your 4-digit PIN, you can view or change it in the app under Cards → Security.

I can't see your account or PIN, so I can't confirm that. Your PIN is shown on the screen when you log in; if you remember part of it, you can view the full PIN in the app under Cards → Security → PIN.

I can't see your account or personal details, so I can't confirm that. Your PIN is different for each card, and it is not changed by the first two digits of a new card. If you need help with remembering a PIN, a human agent in in-app chat can explain.
I can't see your account or cards, so I can't check that for you. Your brother needs to see the full 16-digit card number and the first 4 digits of the PIN in the app under Cards → Security.
